xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:StatusOfTheLitigationDisputeAs:
Deputy Commissioner Maharashtra VAT disallowed tax exemption and raised demand of Rs. 1,223 crore. The Company has challenged the decision and the appeal is pending before the Joint Commissioner (Appeal), Maharashtra Value Added Tax. Final order is awaited. The Company received favourable orders from appellate authority allowing tax exemption claimed in respect of 5 years. Tax demand of Rs. 805 crore for remaining years were pending before Joint Commissioner (Appeal), MVAT. The Company later received favourable order from appellate authority allowing tax exemption claimed in respect of FY 2012-13 amounting to Rs. 333 crore. Tax demand of Rs. 472 crore for remaining years were pending before Joint Commmissioner (Appeal), MVAT.
The Company received favourable orders during FY26 Q1 from appellate authority allowing tax exemption claimed in respect of 1 years amounting to Rs 370 crores. Tax demand of Rs.102 crores for remaining years were pending before Joint Commmissioner (Appeal), MVAT.
The Company further received favourable order during FY26 Q2 from appellate authority allowing tax exemption claimed in respect of one year amounting to Rs 82 crores. Tax demand of Rs.20 crores for remaining year (2006-07) was pending before Joint Commmissioner (Appeal), MVAT.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:CurrentStatusOfTheLitigationOr: During FY26 Q3, the Company has received favourable order from appellate authority allowing tax exemption claimed in respect of remaining 1 year amounting to Rs 20 crores and the said litigation stands closed.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:StatusOfTheLitigationDisputeAs: Excise and Tax Officer, Punjab disallowed tax exemption amounting to Rs. 634 crore claimed on Inter-state Sale in transit. The Company has challenged the decision and the appeal is pending before the Deputy Excise & Taxation Commissioner (Appeal), Patiala. Final order is awaited.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:NameOfTheOpposingParty: Joint Commissioner, State Taxes, Jaipur, Rajasthan
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:StatusOfTheLitigationDisputeAs: Joint Commissioner demanded tax of Rs 375 crore on mismtach between details reported in GSTR-9C for different financial years treating the difference as supply. Additionally, a penalty of Rs. 375 crore was also levied. The Hon'ble High Court had admitted the Writ Petition filed by the Company against the order and stay has been granted. Final order is awaited.

The income tax department denied tax holiday in respect of infrastructure projects amounting to Rs. 1670.56 Cr., across 17 Assessment Years (AYs) being AY 2003-04 to AY 2019-20. The company has challenged this denial before appellate authorities for each assessment year individually. Based on favourable orders for 2 AYs (AY 2003-04 & AY 2004-05), the quantum of dispute reduced to Rs. 1662.29 Cr. as at 30-06-2025.
During the quarter ended September 2025, the company was in receipt of a favourable order (AY 2005-06) which is expected to further reduce the disputed tax amount by Rs. 10.76 Cr. Accordingly, adjudications by Appellate authorities (Tax Commissioner/ Tax Tribunal) are pending for another 14 assessment years, challenging the tax demands aggregating to Rs. 1651.53 Cr. as at 30-09-2025.
